sloka: तत्र गात्रम् हतम् तस्य निर्दग्धस्य महात्मनः ।अशरीरः कृतः कामः क्रोधात् देव ईश्वरेण ह ॥१-२३-१३॥
transliteration: tatra gātram hatam tasya nirdagdhasya mahātmanaḥ ।aśarīraḥ kṛtaḥ kāmaḥ krodhāt deva īśvareṇa ha ॥1-23-13॥

translations.english: Having been completely burnt down by Lord Siva, Kama's body was destroyed. Mighty angry, Siva, reduced Kama to a 'disembodied being.
